name: UTEP Upward Bound
org: University of Texas at El Paso
what_you_do: Get free classes to get ready for college. Get leadership training and ways to help the community all year. Students stay in the program until they finish high school and their first summer at UTEP.
who_can_apply: High school students who attend or live near a school in the program. You must plan to go to college. You must be low income, or neither parent has a bachelor's degree. Schools: Bel Air, Del Valle, Parkland, Riverside and Ysleta (YISD). Also Eastlake, El Dorado, Fabens, Pebble Hills, Socorro and Tornillo (SFT ISDs).
duration: Through high school graduation and the first summer semester at UTEP
deadline_text: No deadline is stated. The application page says first come, first considered. As of Nov 4, 2026, its online form shows as unavailable. Email or call to ask.
how_to_apply: A student and a parent must both finish the application. The online form shows as unavailable as of Nov 4, 2026. Email upwardbound@utep.edu or call (915) 747-5062 to ask how to apply.
notes: Federally funded. Students must qualify to be selected. This is a college prep program, not a job.
